# CLI reference

Generated from the `--help` of the `hub` CLI (argparse). Run `hub <command> --help` for the same information in the terminal.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `0` | ok |
| `1` | failure (check or step) |
| `2` | validation (missing or invalid argument) |
| `3` | authentication |
| `4` | hub unreachable |

## `hub project create`

New app (interactive in a terminal; non-interactive with --yes or without a TTY).

```
hub project create [-h] [--name NAME] [--stack STACK] [--db DB] [--requires REQUIRES] [--dir DIR] [--template {basic,dashboard}] [--with WITH_] [--yes] [--json] [id]
```

| Argument | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | app id (2–32: a-z, 0-9, '-') |  |
| `--name` | display name (default: capitalized id) |  |
| `--stack` | stack (see `hub project stacks`; default python-fastapi) |  |
| `--db` | sqlite (default) or database URL (written to .env DATABASE_URL) |  |
| `--requires` | what the hub provisions: database,storage (default: database) |  |
| `--dir` | target folder (default: ./<id>) |  |
| `--template` (basic \| dashboard) | basic (default) or dashboard (KPIs, charts, table, filter and export) |  |
| `--with` | extras: dashboards (= --template dashboard) |  |
| `--yes`, `-y` | no questions: use the defaults |  |
| `--json` | JSON output |  |

## `hub check`

ruff, ty, pytest+coverage, manifest, openapi and local conformance.

```
hub check [-h] [--dir DIR] [--only ONLY] [--full] [--json]
```

| Argument | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `--dir` |  | `.` |
| `--only` | comma-separated steps: manifesto,ruff,formato,ty,openapi,pytest,identidade,conformidade,porte |  |
| `--full` | also the full contract suite (conformance.json) |  |
| `--json` |  |  |

## `hub pack`

Build the .hubapp package from the app folder (CI, or the manual import on the Deployments screen).

```
hub pack [-h] [--dir DIR] [--image IMAGE] [--build-dir BUILD_DIR] [--dockerfile DOCKERFILE] [--out OUT]
```

| Argument | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `--dir` |  | `.` |
| `--image` | image by digest (name@sha256:…); alternative: --build-dir |  |
| `--build-dir` | build context: the hub builds the package image |  |
| `--dockerfile` | Dockerfile inside --build-dir | `Dockerfile` |
| `--out` |  |  |

## `hub dev`

Lightweight local hub (no Docker) with the app inside the shell.

```
hub dev [-h] [--dir DIR] [--upstream UPSTREAM] [--port PORT] [--role ROLE] [--limits] [command ...]
```

| Argument | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `--dir` |  | `.` |
| `--upstream` | app already running (otherwise the CLI starts the project app) |  |
| `--port` |  | `4173` |
| `--role` |  | `admin` |
| `--limits` |  |  |
| `command` |  |  |

## `hub compare`

Original app × the app in `hub dev`: pages side by side and their difference.

```
hub compare [-h] [--routes ROUTES [ROUTES ...]] [--dir DIR] [--hub HUB] [--original-selector ORIGINAL_SELECTOR] [--login LOGIN] [--max-diff MAX_DIFF] [--min-components MIN_COMPONENTS] original
```

| Argument | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `original` | address of the original app, running (required) |  |
| `--routes` | paths compared on both sides | `['/']` |
| `--dir` |  | `.` |
| `--hub` | `hub dev` address | `http://127.0.0.1:4173` |
| `--original-selector` | part of the original page compared (e.g. main) | `body` |
| `--login` | login page path of the original (form with e-mail/user and password) |  |
| `--max-diff` | largest style difference accepted, in percent | `15.0` |
| `--min-components` | smallest share of the original's components with the same computed style, in percent | `90.0` |

## `hub login`

Sign in: approve the CLI in the browser (OAuth device flow); or save a personal token (CI).

```
hub login [-h] [--hub HUB] [--no-browser] [--token TOKEN] [--token-file TOKEN_FILE] [--json]
```

| Argument | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `--hub` | hub URL (default: HUB_URL or the saved login) |  |
| `--no-browser` | only print the link (do not open the browser) |  |
| `--token` | AVOID: personal token; use HUB_TOKEN or --token-file |  |
| `--token-file` | file with a personal token (e.g. provided by the CI vault) |  |
| `--json` |  |  |

## `hub logout`

Revoke the CLI session on the hub and delete the saved login.

```
hub logout [-h] [--json]
```

| Argument | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` |  |  |

## `hub deploy`

Package and send to the hub (production stays pending approval).

```
hub deploy [-h] --env {staging,production} [--dir DIR] [--hub HUB] [--token TOKEN] [--env-file ENV_FILE] [--yes] [--json]
```

| Argument | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `--env` (staging \| production) |  (required) |  |
| `--dir` |  | `.` |
| `--hub` | hub URL (default: HUB_URL or the one from `hub login`) |  |
| `--token` | AVOID: use `hub login` or HUB_TOKEN |  |
| `--env-file` | values for requires (default: deploy.<env>.env) |  |
| `--yes`, `-y` | no questions |  |
| `--json` |  |  |

## `hub mcp`

stdio MCP server that forwards to the hub MCP with the `hub login` session.

```
hub mcp [-h] [--hub HUB] [--token TOKEN] [--token-file TOKEN_FILE] [--path PATH]
```

| Argument | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `--hub` | hub URL (default: HUB_URL, the saved login, or http://localhost:8080) |  |
| `--token` | AVOID: use `hub login`, HUB_TOKEN or --token-file |  |
| `--token-file` |  |  |
| `--path` |  | `/mcp` |
